# Release channel for each version the release workflow may publish.
#
# Format: <version> <channel>, where channel is `prerelease` or `stable`.
#
# scripts/release-preflight.sh reads this file. It refuses a tag whose version
# has no line here, declares a version twice, names any other channel, or
# declares a version with a prerelease suffix (0.1.0-1) as stable. A prerelease
# is published with prerelease: true, so GitHub never marks it latest, and
# releases/latest/download/latest.json, which the updater reads, never points
# at it.
#
# Add a stable line in the same commit that prepares its CHANGELOG section.

0.0.1 prerelease
